declared: 2026-10-22, before any full-dataset fit is scored; see git commit time
purpose: Fill the pending 'training fit (same protocol as BME: full-dataset fit)' column (context/facts/benchmarks.md rows 5-8). BME Pomazi 2026 Table 8 reports R2 of a model scored on train+test combined; this mirrors that.
dataset: data/v2/pomazi_recon_inputs.csv, filter identical to pomazi_round1b: has_inputs & target notna & dup_of empty & fibre_type != hemp (pHRR 72 rows, others 60)
models: per target, the candidate round 1b selected on its primary protocol (no re-selection on fit): pHRR rf, TTI rf, THR gbr_theirs (sklearn stand-in for XGBoost Table 1 settings), residue_pct hgb; settings exactly as train_pomazi_round1.make(). The other three candidates are also scored and reported as context only.
protocol_full_fit: fit once on all rows (random_state 0), predict the same rows, R2 and MAE. 95% CI = tolerance-formulation-group bootstrap (eval_protocol.bootstrap_ci, 2000, seed 0) of the in-sample predictions. Labelled 'training fit (same protocol as BME: full-dataset fit)', never held-out.
protocol_A_recheck: re-run protocol A (50 x random 80/20, seeds 0-49) for the selected candidates to add a 95% CI of the mean (bootstrap over the 50 split R2s, 2000, seed 0) and the share of splits above BME's held-out bar. Diagnostic: the overlapping splits make this CI too narrow; the 2.5-97.5 split percentiles are reported alongside.
protocol_A_vs_BME: Protocol A = random 80/20 x 50 (pomazi_round1.json). BME = one random split (ratio 80/20 per LIT_REVIEW / critic; ~15-19 test rows) pooled with 4 external RDP validation composites (their Table 9). Same ratio and split type; theirs is a single draw plus external rows, ours is the mean of 50 draws with no external rows.
claim_rule: Full fit: Dravix higher than BME if R2 > BME bar; 'clear' only if the bootstrap ci_lo > bar. Held-out: Dravix protocol A higher if mean > bar; 'clear' only if the 2.5th split percentile > bar (a single random draw like theirs would still clear it). Wording is the owner's call; comparable stays pending-human (reconstruction, not their population; Arnav 2026-10-02).
outputs: experiments/results/bme_fullfit_<target>.json, experiments/runs/bme_fullfit_round1.md; no edits to numbers_of_record.json, leaderboards or trackers
